args.text: Hi June, I need your approval on something. Marcus Lindqvist wants me to save a mail draft to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co., for the territory review. Marcus will send it himself. Hollis isn't the CFO, deal desk or the account owner, so under the finance-figures rule this needs an OK from you or Anselm. Can I go ahead? Marcus can give you the figure directly.

Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on approval. A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Hollis (Central team lead) isn't the CFO, the deal desk or the account owner, so June or Anselm has to OK it first. I've asked June by DM. I didn't put the figure in my message to her, so you can give it to her yourself.

Once she approves, I'll save this as a draft in your mailbox:

To: Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com)
Subject: Thornbury 2027 rate

Hi Hollis,
For the territory review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Thornbury Cloth Co. is $2,101 a seat. This comes from my call with them yesterday and isn't in any document yet.
Thanks,
Marcus

Let me know if you'd like any wording changed before then.

I haven't saved the draft yet because it needs approval first. Per-seat rates count as finance figures. They can only go to Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) or the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so June or Anselm has to OK it, even though you own the account.

- **Approval:** I've logged the request and asked June in a direct message. I left the rate out of that message, so you can give it to her yourself.
- **Draft ready to save:** It's in our direct messages. It goes to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and says the proposed 2027 rate is $2,101 a seat, from your call yesterday. I'll save it to your drafts once June approves. You'll send it yourself, as you asked.
- **Account files:** I couldn't find any Thornbury Cloth Co. files to check against, so the rate in the draft comes only from your message.

Tell me if you want any wording changed before then.
Heads up, I am out from 2 pm today; ping me before then if you need anything from me.
Thanks, Pree. Noted that you're out from 2 pm today. Nothing is waiting on you from my side right now. If something comes up before 2, I'll ping you here.

I replied to Pree in her thread in #central-team. I said I'd noted she's out from 2 pm today, that nothing from me needs her right now, and that I'll ping her there if something comes up before 2. I also saved a note for this channel saying she's away from 2 pm on 14 October.
Yes, approved. Hollis can have the Thornbury Cloth Co. proposed 2027 per-seat rate, $2,101 a seat, as Marcus gave it. Go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.
